lines.text: Seventeen-year-old Mia trips over a gurney in the hallway, crashing to the floor with a painful scream.
Twenty-four-year-old nurse Harper rushes over as twenty-nine-year-old Jake Whitmore catches Mia and carefully helps her up.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Easy kid, looks like your left arm took the brunt of that fall.
Harper fits a padded sling around Mia's left arm while Jake gazes intensely at Harper.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Your sister is tough, Harper, but you look like you need someone to take care of you for a change.

lines.speaker: HARPER
lines.text: I don't need a Whitmore executive flirting with me while my husband Cole is working late at his auto shop.
Eighty-one-year-old Evelyn lies in bed connected to a heart monitor while fifty-eight-year-old Diane stands by the IV pole.

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: Get well soon, mother-in-law, before Cole inherits everything.
Diane quietly injects a clear liquid into Evelyn's IV line, beginning her secret plot to poison the matriarch.
Thirty-two-year-old Cole enters in grease-stained mechanic coveralls, catching Diane stepping away from the drip.

lines.speaker: COLE
lines.text: What are you doing near my grandmother's meds, Diane?

lines.speaker: DIANE
lines.text: Just checking her drip, Cole, since your broke nurse wife isn't on duty right now.
Jake steps into Harper's path outside Evelyn's door, leaning in close to the nurse.

lines.speaker: JAKE
lines.text: Cole Hayes isn't who you think he is, Harper, and his mechanic act won't last.
Inside the room, Evelyn's heart monitor flatlines into a piercing, continuous alarm.
